faq.a: Seven days, one step a day. Most steps take a short sitting. Do not book the meeting until Day 7.
Anyone planning to ask for more pay in their current job.

faq.q: Will it tell me what number to ask for?
faq.a: It walks you through finding the market range and choosing your number. The figure itself is yours to decide.

faq.q: What if my manager says no?
faq.a: Day 3 has you write a plan B for when base pay is frozen, such as a bonus, a title change or a training budget. The pushbacks page also covers common objections.

faq.q: Can I print it or use it on a tablet?
faq.a: Yes. It is a PDF, so any PDF app works. It prints on US Letter or on A4 at fit to page.

faq.q: Is this employment or legal advice?
faq.a: No. General education, not employment or legal advice.
